Film a close shot of pulling the masked hood over your head right before the transition.

Move the camera in for a headless torso close-up and point clearly at the buttons and buttonholes.
Fold each side inward and button it up step by step, pausing after each fastening.
Step back to the opening framing to reveal the cropped fit, then jump-cut with a handbag in hand.
